author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for BrokenLore: Don't Play, an upcoming first-person psychological horror game developed by Serafini Productions. Players will embody Hideo, a young man who's obsessed with video games and eventually receives an experimental console in the mail. From level to level, Hideo's surroundings in his apartment change as he further descends into madness. BrokenLore: Don't Play is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: BrokenLore: Don't Play - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Early Access Updates Roadmap trailer for Morbid Metal, a third-person action melee-based roguelike developed by Screen Juice and Ubisoft. Players will fight across a dark sci-fi world in stylish hack-and-slash fashion. Pull off extensive combos, chain abilities, and overcome challenges in intense action. Ascend the simulation in Morbid Metal, available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Morbid Metal - Official Updates Roadmap Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Moonbrella, a 2D platformer Metroidvania developed by Jett Williams. Use a variety of umbrella tricks to ascend to the moon in this physics-based Metroidvania. Explore a planet abandoned by humans as a lone robot left behind. Journey through dark caves, ancient structures, an active volcano, or revive a dying sunflower trapped in the moon's shadow. Moonbrella will be launching soon on PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Moonbrella - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Powerplex Deep Dive Trailer for Invincible VS, the upcoming fighting game based on the hit comic and Amazon Prime series developed by Quarter Up. Players can get the rundown of the unhinged character of Poweplex, who joins the fight in Invincible VS. Get an in-depth look at the process of development, moveset, techniques, and more about Powerplex. Dish out the rage with Powerplex in Invincible VS, launching on April 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Xbox Cloud, Xbox on PC, and Steam).

#InvincibleVS #Gaming #IGN
title: Invincible VS - Official Powerplex Deep Dive Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Lance Weapon Overview Trailer for Monster Hunter Outlanders, a mobile iteration of the hit open-world monster-hunting RPG developed by TiMi Studio Group. Wield the Lance to deal swift thrusts against enemies, which also offers opportunities for blocks and counterattacks. Monster Hunter Outlanders is coming soon to iOS and Android.

#MonsterHunterOutlanders #Gaming #IGN
title: Monster Hunter Outlanders - Official Weapon Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the 'A Witch's Chill Time' Free Update Trailer for HYKE: Northern Light(s), a 2D top-down action RPG developed by Blast Edge Games Inc. Players can look forward to the new 'A Witch's Chill Time' update for HYKE: Northern Light(s), packed with a new story, new encounters, and new gameplay elements all in a hot sping location. The 'A Witch's Chill Time' update for HYKE: Northern Light(s) is launching on April 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, Apple Arcade, and PC (Steam).
title: HYKE: Northern Light(s) - Official 'A Witch's Chill Time' Free Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Dodo Duckie trailer for this upcoming perspective-swapping puzzle adventure game. The new trailer showcases gameplay, cute characters, and more. Dodo Duckie will be available on PC via Steam on July 23, 2026.
title: Dodo Duckie - Official PC Release Date Announcement Trailer
